messages:
Maria K: Quick follow-up from today's ACME on-prem incident. Postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/ACME-2026-03. Main items: intermittent VPC peering flaps between customer edge and our private node group + an isolation bug that caused routing leaks during failover. Need clear owners and timelines for action items.

Ajay P: Thanks Maria. Quick read — looks like a race during peering re-establish + the onprem adapter didn't rebind the correct netns. Will propose owners.

Kenan O: I'll own VPC peering stability work. Plan: runbook patch + add a circuit-level healthcheck and exponential backoff on peering reattempts. Prototype by Tue EOD. I'll open a JIRA and link it here.

Kenan O: Healthcheck sketch I'll add to runbook:
```
# probe peer state from node
curl -sS http://localhost:9100/peers | jq '.[] | select(.status!="ok")'
```
I'll also add metrics for consecutive fail counts.

Eli R: I'll take the runtime isolation bug. Action: enforce tenant route hygiene on failover and add a CI e2e that simulates peer detach/reattach. ETA: end of week. I'll include a minimal repro in the PR.

Jordan Ops: I'll own the on-prem deployment checklist and verify iptables/route policies with ACME's config snapshot. Will ask them for the config and a timestamped export. ETA: tomorrow noon.

SRE Bot: Created tickets RN-7821 (VPC peering probe + runbook), RN-7822 (runtime isolation regression test + fix). Linked to INC-4532. Severity: P2.

Ajay P: Can we add a guardrail to inhibit autoscale during peering flaps? That might stop some blast radius. Who can take design? @Kenan O?

Kenan O: Yep I can add an autoscale inhibition flag in the routing service and expose it as a rollout param. Quick patch early next week. Will coordinate deployment window with Jordan.

Maria K: Summary/ownership (I'm creating a shared tracker and will run a 15m weekly sync for 3 weeks — first meeting Wed 9am PT):
- Kenan O: VPC peering runbook + healthcheck (RN-7821) — prototype Tue EOD
- Eli R: Runtime isolation fix + CI/e2e tests (RN-7822) — EOW
- Jordan Ops: On-prem deployment checklist & config verification (RN-7823) — tomorrow noon
- Ajay P: Sprint prioritization, autoscale-inhibition design, postmortem writeup — EOD today
- Maria K: Status tracker + weekly sync (recurring) :spiral_calendar:

Eli R: Note: reproduction required sequence: detach peering -> trigger failover -> reattach. I'll include the DR script and a minimal harness in the PR so CI can simulate it.

Jordan Ops: @acme-eng can you share the peering configs and the BGP neighbor states? Prefer a tarball with timestamps.

Ajay P: Ack, I'll add the autoscale inhibition design doc to the tracker and link RN-7824 for the design ticket.

Maria K: Thanks — if anything slips, call it out in the tracker. I'll close this Slack thread and we'll move updates to the tracker doc / JIRA links. :thumbsup:
